title: The agent lifecycle: timelines, archiving idle sessions, the restart test, the cheapest model per role
why: Dinis's record 2026-11-24__agent-lifecycle asks for fewer live agents, every agent restartable from GitHub state, and cheaper models where they suffice. Proposal: https://maestro.agents.sovereignweb.site/factory/dinis-cruz/account-b/proposals/2026-11-24__agent-lifecycle.md
checks: accountant.b to add costs per role
options: 1) Timeline: active_until at most 7 days, renewed on work
2) Archive when idle 48 h, no wake, no open ask, nothing waiting on Dinis; hand-over, retire key, vault keys to maestro first; first list as a decision block
3) The restart test once per agent type this week

4) The model table (Opus for maestros, conductors, decisions, security, strategy, counsel; Sonnet for keepers, devops, observability, feedback, librarian, accountant; Haiku or Sonnet for sub-agents), each role switched only after its restart test passes
